sources.title: Mitigating Hallucination in Large Language Models (LLMs): An ...

sources.title: Large Language Models for Information Retrieval: A Survey
sources.snippet: From the model perspective, a strongly representational neural architecture allows retrievers to effectively store and apply knowledge obtained from the training data. Unfortunately, there are some long-term challenges that hinder the advancement of retrieval models.

sources.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation-based Large Language Model Chatbot
sources.snippet: We introduced a memory-augmented chatbot system to enhance the conversational capabilities of large language models (LLMs) using retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). The system enables fluid, context-aware dialogue by integrating historical interactions into the reasoning process.
